Zoe (CS): capturing asks from Nimbus Health onboarding call. renewal check-in in ~2w, finance + security both pressing. dropping raw asks here for triage.

Zoe (CS): raw asks: 1) Self-service KMS key rotate + key version UI so their security team can rotate keys without opening tickets. 2) Renewal packet: monthly PDF/CSV that includes per-environment (prod/stage/dev) cost trends, 90d anomalies, and a 1-paragraph summary executives can send to procurement. 3) Env-scoped route tagging so they can apply budgets to staging/dev separately from prod. 4) Embeddings privacy logs: exportable consent/audit log for specific datasets (compliance requirement).

Marco (PM): thanks. can you add impact notes? renewal in 2w means finance/security asks are high priority.

Zoe (CS): impact: 1=high (security policy + audit), 2=high (procurement needs for renewal), 3=medium (cost-control), 4=high (compliance). Customer said procurement won't sign until they can show a rotation plan + audit exports.

Lina (Eng): feasibility quick take: 1) KMS rotate UI = small-medium (console UI + backend KMS calls + IAM checks). 2) renewal packet = small (aggregation + PDF templating + CSV export). 3) env-scoped tagging = small (metadata + reporting filter). 4) consent/audit log export = medium (logging pipeline + redaction + RBAC). Security review required for 1 & 4.

Marco (PM): proposed triage: P0 = KMS rotate UI spike + audit-export spec; P1 = renewal packet (CSV + PDF); P2 = env tagging & budget scoping. Lina, can you take a 1d spike on KMS rotation mechanics and security touchpoints?

Lina (Eng): will pick up Monday. I'll scope API changes and identify KMS provider integration impacts.

Raj (SE): workaround notes: we can run manual key rotation via our infra team for now and provide a signed export of current keys/versions. For the renewal packet, here's a quick script customers can run to produce a per-environment CSV until we ship a PDF template:

```
# manual env cost dump (pseudo)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage?account=nimbus&group_by=environment,route&start=2026-06-01&end=2026-06-30" | jq -r '.environments[] | [.env, .route, .tokens, .cost] | @csv' > nimbus-jun-env-costs.csv
```
Priya (Enablement): I can run a focused enablement + security sync tomorrow 30m to demo the manual script and outline the KMS rotation steps. We'll record it for their procurement team.

Marco (PM): I'll open two tickets: (A) spike: KMS rotate UI + security review (P0), (B) renewal packet CSV/PDF (P1). Lina, tag security on the spike. Raj, can you draft the CSV template we can hand to Nimbus?

Raj (SE): on it. will post template later today.

Zoe (CS): customer update plan: immediate enablement + manual exports + infra-run key rotation while product spikes KMS UI. Nimbus said they feel better and will pause procurement escalation until we share the recording and the infra rotation confirmation.
